major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Dance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use with Secret Technique or during Shadow Blades, avoiding casting during a global cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Blades
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use when Shadow Dance is ready to maximize combo point generation and damage.

major_cooldowns.name: Secret Technique
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast during Shadow Dance at 6 or more combo points.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use offensively on cooldown at low combo points.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Use to clear and immune magic effects.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Use preemptively to reduce incoming AoE damage.

rules.action: Always ensure Shadow Dance is cast when activating Shadow Blades.
Only cast Secret Technique while Shadow Dance is active.

rules.description: High Combo Points for Secret Technique
rules.action: Ensure you have 6 or more Combo Points before casting Secret Technique.
Use Vanish at low combo points to maximize builder efficiency from stealth.

source_summary: Subtlety Rogue concentrates all its damage into short cooldown windows. The rotation revolves around aligning Secret Technique and Shadow Blades precisely within Shadow Dance, ensuring maximum combo point generation and expenditure without overcapping.
